summary: AMTD IDEA Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing an exhibit containing the interim results of its subsidiary, The Generation Essentials Group (NYSE: TGE; LSE: TGE), for the six months ended June 30, 2026. TGE reported revenue from contracts with customers up 35.8% to US$30.8 million, hospitality revenue up 59.8%, net profit of US$22.8 million, EPS of US$0.56, total assets of US$1.8 billion and net asset value of US$932.5 million. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation or advisor were stated. Watch for further subsidiary disclosures rather than deal activity.
